# Arcarius Digital

> Fixed-price websites for Malaysian businesses - kedai runcit, bengkel, salon, tuition centres, F&B/food businesses, and grocery stores. WhatsApp-first, no monthly fees. Based in Malaysia.

## Pricing

- Starter (RM899, one-time): mobile-first website plus a free Google Business Profile fix.
- Complete (RM1499, one-time, most popular): everything in Starter plus one manual process fixed - a booking page or an order page.
- Complete Plus (RM2989, one-time): everything in Complete plus both a booking page and an order page, plus a priority build slot.
- Makeover (RM128/hour): redesign of a website the business already has, quoted in estimated hours after a look at the site.

## Key facts

- Typical build timeline: 2-5 business days, depending on the request.
- Payment: 50% deposit before work begins, 50% due on delivery. No monthly fees or subscriptions on any option.
- MSME Digital Grant (Geran Digital PMKS Madani) can offset up to 50% of the package fee, up to RM5000, for SSM-registered Malaysian businesses meeting eligibility criteria.
- Contact: WhatsApp +60 16-426 1472, email arcariusdigital@gmail.com
